subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

She have been spending / all her money on her flat / to make it more decorative.

options.text: All her money on her flat

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The subject-verb agreement is incorrect in this part of the sentence. 
 
• **"She"** is a singular subject, so it requires the singular form of the verb **"has" **instead of** "have."**
 
• The correct form should be <strong
